research.title: Preprocessing Support for Customer Request Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned text normalization and label mapping routines for customer requests, following an established preprocessing specification.
Checked processed examples for empty text and inconsistent labels, documenting exceptions for review before baseline training.

work.title: Inventory and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory records by reconciling delivery paperwork with received items and reporting discrepancies to the responsible staff.
Prepared order documents, organized incoming requests, and coordinated routine status updates between dispatch staff and customer service.

projects.title: TF-IDF Baseline for Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented a review sentiment baseline using TF-IDF features and logistic regression, fitting the vocabulary exclusively on training data.
Evaluated predictions using macro F score and a confusion matrix, inspecting misclassified reviews for negation and mixed sentiment.
